meta.notice: PolicyEngine estimates of the Scottish Budget 2027-28.

basis.gross_or_net: gross cost or yield to the Scottish Government before any block grant adjustment
basis.behaviour: static: no behavioural response unless a measure says so

measures.name: Starter and basic rate thresholds raised
measures.description: Top of the starter band to £17,116 and top of the basic band to £30,559 from April 2027.
measures.basis_note: Measured against the costings' baseline: the 2026-27 starter and basic thresholds held in cash terms. 2028-29 assumes the thresholds stay at the 2027-28 level, as the statement gives no 2028-29 value.

measures.name: Higher, advanced and top thresholds held
measures.description: The higher, advanced and top rate thresholds stay at £43,662, £75,000 and £125,140 (rates start at £43,663, £75,001 and £125,141) in 2027-28 and 2028-29.
measures.basis_note: Already current law, so it costs nothing against the baseline.

measures.name: Advanced rate up 1p
measures.description: Advanced rate from 45% to 46% from April 2027.
measures.basis_note: Static: no behavioural response. Costings that include behaviour will be smaller.

measures.name: Scottish property income rates
measures.description: Property income of Scottish taxpayers taxed at each Scottish rate plus 2p from April 2027.

measures.name: Additional Dwelling Supplement raised
measures.description: Additional Dwelling Supplement on second homes and buy-to-let purchases from 8% to 10%, from 4 December 2026.
measures.basis_note: Static: the number of purchases does not change. Purchases are modelled, not observed. The part of 2026-27 from 4 December 2026 is not costed here.

measures.name: Non-domestic rates held
measures.description: Basic, intermediate and higher property rates held at 48.1p, 53.5p and 54.8p.
measures.basis_note: A business tax, outside the model; the official costing is recorded.

measures.name: Air Departure Tax rates
measures.description: Air Departure Tax rates for 2027-28 match the UK's Air Passenger Duty.
measures.basis_note: Not a household tax in the model; the official costing is recorded.

measures.name: Council tax freeze
measures.description: Council tax bills held at 2026-27 levels in 2027-28.
measures.basis_note: Council tax is a cost to councils; the Scottish Government's funding to councils for the freeze is not modelled. Bills grow as forecast from the frozen level in 2028-29.

measures.name: Council tax Bands I and J
measures.description: New bands from April 2028: Band I for homes over £1m at 3.00 times Band D, Band J over £2m at 3.50 times.
measures.reason: Bands I and J apply from 2028-29. Scottish home values in the data are not revalued from sale prices, no Scottish home in the data is worth over £2m and the model has no Band J, so the new bands cannot be costed.

measures.name: Scottish benefits uprated by 3.5%
measures.description: Scottish benefits up 3.5% from April 2027: Scottish Child Payment £29.20, Carer Support Payment £89.50 and Scottish Carer Supplement £12.10 a week.
measures.basis_note: Already current law, so it costs nothing against the baseline.

measures.name: Scottish Child Payment premium for children under one
measures.description: Scottish Child Payment of £40.00 a week in total for each child under one from April 2027.
measures.basis_note: Costed for a full year from April 2027; 2028-29 uses the model's uprated amount.

measures.name: Young parent payment
measures.description: £10.00 a week per family from 1 October 2027 for families receiving Scottish Child Payment with a parent under 25.
measures.basis_note: 2027-28 counts 188 of 366 days, from 1 October 2027; 2028-29 a full year.

measures.name: Adult Disability Payment mobility descriptors
measures.description: Changes to the mobility component descriptors from April 2028.
measures.reason: Adult Disability Payment is carried as PIP; a change to ADP rules cannot be applied to the data.

measures.name: £100 payment for homes in council tax Bands A to D
measures.description: A one-off £100 towards energy bills for each household in Bands A to D, paid by 31 March 2027.
measures.basis_note: Paid by 31 March 2027, so it falls in 2026-27, before the years shown here (2027-28 and 2028-29). PolicyEngine static estimate for 2026-27: £185m to about 1.85 million households.

measures.name: £2 bus fare cap across Scotland
measures.description: The £2 single bus fare cap extended across Scotland from 1 June 2027.
measures.basis_note: Spending, outside the model; the official costing is recorded.
